objects.name: Analytic 2123
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a process whose executable name matches a known Industrial Control System (ICS) service daemon but whose execution path falls outside the documented vendor installation directories, or whose binary hash does not match the package manager's recorded checksum for that package. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.
